reasons: Section 9 originally contained only mutual authority representations and the Globix carve-out, so no performance warranty existed; a concise inserted subsection (c) is the minimal fix for an absent clause.

All preferred atomic elements are express: professional and workmanlike Services (90 days), Site/deliverable/software conformance to documentation (12 months), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair, replacement or refund.

The insertion defines "Services" inline, which is necessary because the term was otherwise undefined; no other operative text was altered and the existing subsections (a) and (b) remain fully effective.
Minor sub-elements short of ideal (remedy sequencing at HDI's option and refund limited to fees "paid") are worth noting in rationale only, not deviations.
